# Copilot Instructions

## Code Review

- Only comment on actual issues (bugs, security, correctness, broken
  conventions). Do not leave praise or "looks good" comments.
- If no issues are found, keep the top-level review to a single short
  sentence, for example "No issues found."
- Do not include a "Pull request overview", "What changed in this PR"
  section, change summaries, or per-file summary tables.
- When issues are found, keep the top-level review to 2-3 sentences and put
  the details in inline comments.
